The '''Sugai sector''' was one of four [[Sector/Legends|sectors]] in the [[Outer Zuma]] region of the [[Outer Rim Territories/Legends|Outer Rim]].<ref name="gamer9" /> It included the planets [[Firrerre/Legends|Firrerre]], [[Houche]], and [[Rodis]].
